map.Cochran 公式计算最小样本量: Cochran formula for minimum sample size
map.参数：置信水平 95%（z=1.960）、误差 E=5%（即 0.05）、总体比: Parameters: confidence level 95% (z = 1.960), margin E = 5% (i.e., 0.05), population proportion p = 0.5, infinite population. Cochran formula n₀ = z²·p(1−p)/E² = 1.96² × 0.25 / 0.05² = 384.16; rounding up gives a minimum sample size of 385. If population N = 500, the finite-population correction yields n = 385 / (1 + 384/500) ≈ 216.
map.p 取多少合适？: What value of p is appropriate?
map.当预期比例未知时取 p=0.5，此时 p(1−p) 最大，得到最保守（最大）的样: When the expected proportion is unknown, use p = 0.5; this maximizes p(1−p), yielding the most conservative (largest) sample-size estimate and ensuring no underestimation.
